newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine parliament backs 1997 privatisation plan.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine parliament backs 1997 privatisation plan.

text.p: The Ukrainian parliament has approved the government's 1997 privatisation plan and a senior deputy said on Wednesday that the final document differed little from a document approved by the president last month.
"The plan approved by parliament is pretty well the same as the plan approved by the president," Alexander Ryabchenko, head of parliament's privatisation committee, told Reuters.
He said parliament had added a few small-scale enterprises to the list of firms to be privatised.

Parliament late on Tuesday supported the plan to sell off 1,440 medium and large companies and about 3,400 small firms this year. Most sales will be in agriculture and food processing, where 780 medium and large companies will be sold.
The State Property Fund has sold at least 70 percent of 6,339 medium and large companies since January 1995. A further 9,649 companies are in the process of being privatised.
